citations.title: Tracy A. Robinson

sentences.quote: She formally took her position as CEO on February 28, 2022, becoming the first female CEO of a Canadian railway.
sentences.text: Tracy A. Robinson has served as president and chief executive officer of Canadian National Railway since February 28, 2022, becoming the first woman to lead the company and the first female CEO of a Canadian railway, succeeding Jean-Jacques Ruest, and she also sits on CN's board.

She was appointed after more than 30 years in Canada's railroad and energy industries, joining CN from TC Energy, where she was executive vice-president and president of Canadian Natural Gas Pipelines and Coastal GasLink, following 27 years at Canadian Pacific in commercial, operations and finance roles.

sentences.quote: Robinson earned a bachelors of communication at the University of Saskatchewan and a masters of business administration at the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School of Business.
sentences.text: She holds an MBA from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania and a Bachelor of Commerce from the University of Saskatchewan, and earned her Institute of Corporate Directors designation in 2015.
She is also chair of the Business Council of Canada.

sentences.quote: MONTREAL, Oct. 20, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CN (TSX: CNR) (NYSE: CNI) announced today the appointments of Patrick Whitehead as Executive Vice-President and Chief Operating Officer as well as Janet Drysdale as Executive Vice-President and Chief Commercial Officer, effective immediately. Patrick's appointment follows the departure of Derek Taylor from the Company.
sentences.text: Tracy Robinson remains president and chief executive, with CN naming Patrick Whitehead executive vice-president and chief operating officer and Janet Drysdale executive vice-president and chief commercial officer on October 20, 2025, effective immediately, Whitehead's appointment following the departure of Derek Taylor; Robinson framed both as central to reaching new levels of operational, commercial and customer service excellence and to delivering shareholder value.
Madeleine Paquin, former LOGISTEC chief executive, joined the board effective October 29, 2025.
